articles.headline: Nvidia customers warned of AI server price hikes as memory costs surge
articles.summary: Some of Nvidia’s largest customers have reportedly been told server prices will rise by more than 15% in many cases because memory costs are climbing. That directly affects AI infrastructure budgets, data-center planning, and the economics of deploying new AI workloads for large and mid-sized businesses.

articles.headline: Orbital data center startup Starcloud reaches $2.3 billion valuation
articles.summary: Starcloud’s latest funding highlights continued investor interest in alternative data-center infrastructure. Businesses tracking cloud costs, AI compute supply, and long-term infrastructure diversification should watch whether orbital compute moves from concept toward practical capacity.

articles.headline: Citi, HSBC and StanChart adopt Ant International’s forex AI tool
articles.summary: Ant International launched an upgraded AI model for liquidity-risk management and said major global banks are adopting it. For finance teams, the story signals faster AI adoption in treasury operations, foreign-exchange risk management, and cross-border cash planning.
